correctness.rationale: The incidence identity L(L(G))=diag(d_u+d_v)-B^T B holds for every simple base graph. Explicit matching-pair eigenvectors, pair-constant contrasts, unmatched contrasts, and the two-class quotient exhaust all n dimensions and give every displayed factor. Negative powers cancel by explicit polynomial identities for t=1,r=1,2. Discriminant comparisons prove exactly when a nonintegral root survives. The separate exact checker agrees with the direct characteristic polynomials for 24 parameter values n=4..9, but the unrestricted claim rests on the symbolic proof. n=4,t=1 and both regular endpoints are handled explicitly.

value.rationale: The evaluated polynomial gives every Laplacian eigenvalue for a natural two-parameter family interpolating between the triangular graph and a perfect-matching cocktail-party line graph. It supplies a sharp all-order integrality boundary with a genuine isolated small exception and proves an irrational-eigenvalue obstruction in every other partial deletion. The structured irregular transition is not subsumed by generic tree-count identity or base adjacency-spectrum results; it is more than a routine numerical special case.
